note: Measured, not chosen. 1000 books drawn by metadata from a frame of 17343, stratified by language of composition, era and genre. A number outside a band is a difference and never a fault.

sources.lexical_note: prose measured on the 786 files that segment; 214 of 1000 refuse and cannot be chaptered

frame.definition: Type=Text; Library of Congress class in PR/PS/PQ/PT/PG, which fixes language of composition and survives translation; Subjects or Bookshelves naming fiction or a novel; first author datable.
